artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The drawing depicts a man on a cross at the center, with a halo around his head, flanked by two figures on either side. The background is sparsely detailed, but the figures are adorned with detailed patterns and clothing. On the left, there are two individuals wearing robes and head coverings, while on the right, two individuals appear to be wearing hats and armors. This drawing features strong, bold lines, decorative textures, and simple color accents.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing a figure being lowered from a cross. The image is detailed in a style resembling medieval woodcuts, with strong lines and a limited color palette. The scene includes several figures working together to bring down the central figure from the cross. One figure on the left is on a ladder assisting in the task, wearing a green hat. The other figures wear clothing with intricate patterns. The image is framed by a decorative border with floral motifs.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: The image features four figures in the foreground. One figure is reclining with their full body visible, supported by another figure. Surrounding them are three standing figures with distinctive halos around their heads. The figures are wearing cloaked garments and have stoic expressions. One of the standing figures is supporting the head of the reclining figure. In the background, there is a large cross and ornate floral border patterns.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures gathered around a bed or bier. The figures are depicted with halos and dressed in clothing typical of the medieval or renaissance periods. The central figures wear robes and the two figures in the background are wrapped in cloaks. There is an ornate patterned border framing the scene, and some figures wear green head coverings. The style is reminiscent of medieval religious art, with strong outlines and a modest use of color.

artworks.title: The Three Maries at the Tomb
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures gathered around a tomb. There is an angel with a green and brown wing on the left, gesturing towards three haloed figures by the tomb. The tomb is detailed with intricate patterns and textiles, and the background features an elaborate border with golden floral patterns, similar to early Renaissance religious art.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to the Magdalene as a Gardner
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One figure is standing while the other is kneeling. The standing figure is depicted facing forward with one hand raised holding a shovel and the other hand resting by his side. He has long hair and a beard and a halo around his head. He is wearing a robe and standing barefoot on patchy green ground. The kneeling figure is shown beside the standing figure. She has long hair covered with a veil or headscarf, a halo around her head, and wears draped robes with a cloak. The background includes woven wicker structures, greenery, a textured tree with dense foliage, and a decorative border of yellow and orange floral motifs.

artworks.title: The Ascension
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a group of figures surrounded by halos, gesturing towards a central point where hands and feet are visible. The figures wear robes with intricate patterns, and are enclosed by a border with floral motifs in gold tones. The style is reminiscent of medieval or early Renaissance religious art.

artworks.title: Pentecost
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures in a religious scene. The scene features a central figure in the middle surrounded by others, all with halos around their heads. Above them, a dove is depicted with outstretched wings emanating rays downward toward the group. The overall composition is framed with a decorative border that incorporates rich gold colors. The painting has an intricate pattern around the edge and uses a limited color palette dominated by gold, brown, and black tones.

artworks.title: Christ's Descent in Limbo
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene. The artwork features a central figure with a halo holding a staff or banner. The scene includes other figures in distress. The background has intricate patterns resembling feathers or flames. The borders are adorned with floral and leaf patterns. This is in the style of medieval religious art.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a tree with a serpent. The image depicts a central tree with a lush canopy of leaves, surrounded by an ornate border with floral patterns in gold and black. Winding its way around the tree's trunk is a large serpent. At the base of the tree, there is shrubbery. Traditional elements indicate a story with roots in religious or mythological themes. This is in the style of Renaissance biblical illustration.

artworks.title: The Expulsion from the Garden of Eden
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of abstracted figures in a scene under a tree. It is rendered in a stylized manner reminiscent of medieval woodcut techniques, with bold outlines, limited color palette, and an intricate pattern. The central figure wears a robe and wields a sword. To the right, a pair of figures is positioned closely together, one holding foliage. The background includes a tree and a detailed structure. The border is detailed with leaves and floral motifs. The faces and actions suggest a narrative unfolding within a mystical or allegorical realm.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. One is seated and has a halo-like circle around the head. The facial features are stylized, with large eyes and a serene expression. The person wears a long robe and leans on a lectern with an open book. To the left, an angelic figure stands, facing the seated person. This figure has delicate facial features, wavy hair, and large wings. The clothing is ornate, with a high collar and voluminous sleeves, holding a lit candle. The background features architectural elements drawn in a medieval style, along with intricate framing patterns.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring two figures with halos, set against a background of a medieval castle and a lush landscape. The artwork is done in a religious medieval style, with gilded halos, stylized drapery, a golden border with intricate foliate patterns, and small, dotted patterning throughout the depiction of the robes and background. The two figures are shown engaging in an interaction, set against a detailed countryside featuring green shrubs and an ornate town or castle.

artworks.title: The Circumcision
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: The image shows five adult figures surrounding a seated child. Most of their bodies are visible, from the waist up. The adults appear to be standing around the seated child, who is being held. The child is depicted with simplistic facial features and short hair. Three of the adults wear distinctive headdresses, one has a pointed, green hat, and another wears a polka-dotted garment. One adult is shown holding a large circular object similar to a plate. The fifth adult is kneeling with hands extended towards the child. The adults wear ornate clothing, including long robes with patterns. The background is plain, with a border of yellow leaves along the edges.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene involving a child and attendants. The image depicts three figures surrounding a central infant figure. The figures are dressed in ornate, flowing garments with detailed patterns, and each has a halo indicating their significance. The child held in the center appears to be a focal point. The scene is set within a structured architectural background that includes arches and decorative motifs. This painting, with its stylized figures and medieval aesthetic, evokes the style of early Gothic or Renaissance religious artwork. The colors are muted, with predominantly earth tones.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Feet of the Apostles
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: The image shows a group of haloed figures in a religious scene. The central figure is washing the feet of a seated figure. The background and borders are decorated with floral patterns. The style of the piece is reminiscent of medieval or early Renaissance religious art. The image is in the style of a woodcut print, known for its ability to produce detailed copies. The composition features a limited color palette with an emphasis on line work and patterns.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a circular formation with a central figure holding a circular object. The image displays a gathering of haloed figures in a tight composition around a central figure who is prominently holding a circular object. Each figure is intricately detailed with distinctive facial expressions and attire. The color palette consists mainly of subdued tones, with golden accents. The outer perimeter of the image is bordered with an ornate design that frames the entire composition. The scene exudes a sense of harmony and spiritual significance.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene involving figures in a garden setting. The central figure kneels with hands clasped, gazing towards a golden chalice with a cross on top, while surrounded by three other reclining figures. The background includes stylized trees and a decorative floral border.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals engaged in a scene. The central figure is seated and has a serene expression, with long hair and a beard, adorned in a flowing reddish-brown garment with a circular clasp at the chest. Surrounding this figure are three other individuals. One stands to the left, holding a sword or dagger, with a focused expression and short hair. Another person on the right, standing behind the seated figure, appears to be wearing a green headpiece and dark clothing, holding a staff or pole, with a distinct upward gaze. The last individual, kneeling in the foreground, also has short hair and is depicted reaching towards the seated figure with an earnest expression and simple robe. The background consists of ornate floral patterns, with some greenery at the bottom that adds to the decorative style of this scene. The entire scene is framed by a border of intricate floral motifs.

artworks.title: The Expulsion from the Garden of Eden
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. The person on the left is standing with one arm extended upwards, holding a sword, and wearing a robe-like garment with long sleeves and a belted waist. The other two figures are standing closely together; one with a beard and longer flowing hair while the other has shorter hair, and both are shown without clothing except for fig leaves covering their lower bodies. They exhibit distressed expressions. In the background, there is a tree with green foliage and architectural elements resembling a decorative arch. The ground is depicted with green plants and foliage.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing close to each other. Both individuals have stylized facial features, including prominent eyes, noses, and lips, and are wearing long robes with intricate patterns. They are enveloped in halos and are holding each other's hand and arm. The background features a green area with stylized plants or trees and an earthy texture, framed by a dark border.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with figures surrounding the cross. The central wooden cross holds a crucified figure, with individuals standing on either side. All figures wear decorative haloes, except one who holds a sword on the right side. The artwork features bold outlines and vibrant colors like red, green, and yellow, highlighting the clothing and background. The figures exhibit expressive postures, some in gestures of mourning or reverence. The style resembles medieval woodcut or early printmaking with prominent line work and patterns.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting of a central figure seated on a raised structure with religious and symbolic iconography. The central figure is shown with a halo, holding a long staff with a draped flag. The figure wears a robe in shades of red with yellow highlights. The foreground features intricate patterns and a sense of depth through cross-hatching and bold outlines. Elements like the staff, flag, and implied motion add a dynamic quality to the painting. The color palette is limited, combining muted greens, reds, and yellows against a textured background.
